natural_language: All pointer parameters must be validated before dereferencing
rationale: Null pointer dereferences are a leading cause of crashes. By validating all pointers at function entry, we prevent cascading failures.
alternatives: Let it crash and catch in signal handler
rejection_reasons: assert() disappears in release builds - unsafe
Signal handlers are platform-specific and unreliable
C doesn't have optional types natively
Static analysis can miss runtime conditions
